mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT A.RECRUITMENT_NO AS RECRUITMENT_NO, REGEXP_SUBSTR( SUBSTR(I.BUSINESS_ADDRESS, INSTR(I.BUSINESS_ADDRESS, '^^^') + 3, INSTR(I.BUSINESS_ADDRESS || '^^^', '^^^', INSTR(I.BUSINESS_ADDRESS, '^^^') + 3) - INSTR(I.BUSINESS_ADDRESS, '^^^') - 3), '[^ ]+ [^ ]+', 1, 1 ) AS BUSINESS_ADDRESS, I.BUSINESS_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, A.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS RECRUITMENT_TITLE, A.RECRUITMENT_CONTENT AS RECRUITMENT_CONTENT, A.RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, A.JOBTYPE_NO AS JOBTYPE_NO, A.NUM_OF_RECRUITMENT_NAME AS NUM_OF_RECRUITMENT_NAME, A.SALARY_NO AS SALARY_NO, J.SALARY_NAME AS SALARY_NAME, K.TIME_NAME AS TIME_NAME, A.GRADE_NO AS GRADE_NO, A.PERIOD_NO AS PERIOD_NO, A.DAYS_NO AS DAYS_NO, A.TIME_NO AS TIME_NO, A.EMPLOYER_NO AS EMPLOYER_NO, A.SALARY_MOUNT AS SALARY_MOUNT, A.WRITE_DATE AS WRITE_DATE, A.UPDATE_DATE AS UPDATE_DATE, A.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL AS RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL, A.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, A.RECRUIT_COMPLETE_FL AS RECRUIT_COMPLETE_FL, A.RECRUITMENT_PROFILE AS RECRUITMENT_PROFILE, A.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO ASWORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO FROM RECRUITMENT A JOIN EMPLOYER I ON A.EMPLOYER_NO = I.EMPLOYER_NO JOIN SALARY J ON A.SALARY_NO = J.SALARY_NO JOIN WORKCOND_TIME K ON A.TIME_NO = K.TIME_NO WHERE A.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY A.WRITE_DATE DESC

SELECT DISTINCT A.RECRUITMENT_NO AS RECRUITMENT_NO, REGEXP_SUBSTR( SUBSTR(I.BUSINESS_ADDRESS, INSTR(I.BUSINESS_ADDRESS, '^^^') + 3, INSTR(I.BUSINESS_ADDRESS || '^^^', '^^^', INSTR(I.BUSINESS_ADDRESS, '^^^') + 3) - INSTR(I.BUSINESS_ADDRESS, '^^^') - 3), '[^ ]+ [^ ]+', 1, 1 ) AS BUSINESS_ADDRESS, I.BUSINESS_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, A.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS RECRUITMENT_TITLE, A.RECRUITMENT_CONTENT AS RECRUITMENT_CONTENT, A.RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, A.JOBTYPE_NO AS JOBTYPE_NO, A.NUM_OF_RECRUITMENT_NAME AS NUM_OF_RECRUITMENT_NAME, A.SALARY_NO AS SALARY_NO, J.SALARY_NAME AS SALARY_NAME, K.TIME_NAME AS TIME_NAME, A.GRADE_NO AS GRADE_NO, A.PERIOD_NO AS PERIOD_NO, A.DAYS_NO AS DAYS_NO, A.TIME_NO AS TIME_NO, A.EMPLOYER_NO AS EMPLOYER_NO, A.SALARY_MOUNT AS SALARY_MOUNT, A.WRITE_DATE AS WRITE_DATE, A.UPDATE_DATE AS UPDATE_DATE, A.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL AS RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL, A.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, A.RECRUIT_COMPLETE_FL AS RECRUIT_COMPLETE_FL, A.RECRUITMENT_PROFILE AS RECRUITMENT_PROFILE, A.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO ASWORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO FROM RECRUITMENT A JOIN EMPLOYER I ON A.EMPLOYER_NO = I.EMPLOYER_NO JOIN SALARY J ON A.SALARY_NO = J.SALARY_NO JOIN WORKCOND_TIME K ON A.TIME_NO = K.TIME_NO WHERE A.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND A.RECRUITMENT_NO= 16 ORDER BY A.WRITE_DATE DESC
